correctness.rationale: For m>=5, maximal faces of pairwise-intersecting two-subsets are the m star simplices and exceptional triangles. The star union has H1 integrally the cycle lattice of K_m, identified equivariantly with wedge^2 ker(epsilon:Z^m->Z); every exceptional oriented triangle attaches by contraction delta:wedge^3 Z^m -> wedge^2 U. Splitting by a vector of augmentation 1 shows delta surjective, ker delta=wedge^3 U integrally and naturally, without using a non-equivariant contraction. Exterior-character determinant gives [t^3] prod(1-(-t)^lambda)/(1+t). Finite invariants are exact over Q so rational quotient H2 is C_m-averaged character; independently computed cyclic dimensions for all 5<=m<=29. Entire source verifier calculates mod2 homology and signed permutation traces up through m8; finite cases only corroborate the unrestricted topological proof.
